name: Topdeck Automat
description:
About This Game

Topdeck Automat combines the best of both worlds: auto-battler + roguelike deckbuilder.

Let Your Deck Auto-Battle

Draft from 200+ cards and apply custom upgrades to them to create a synergistic combat engine. Since your deck is shuffled and spit out at random by your printer droid, you will have to find ways to deal with the RNG: Chain effect triggers like crazy, and support your deck with 100+ stackable passive modules to push its efficiency to the max!

Designed For Replayability

Choose one of 30 unlockable characters every run, each one putting their own twist on the gameplay. No grind, all variety! Combined with 50 different enemy types and a dozen bosses to build around, no two runs are the same. Daily challenges and randomized weather effects will constantly keep you on your toes.

Play Your Way

Going for a loose from-the-hip playstyle? The game's difficulty settings (incl. an option to disable permadeath) won't lock you out of any content or achievements. Want to optimize every choice? Crank up the challenge and take full advantage of the game's transparency. Check your deck, collection, modules, run info and boss preview anytime!

Bury your enemies under a flurry of attacks, shield to stall until the storm defeats them for you, freeze them just before they land a devestating blow, go for huge critical hits, stack infection damage, boost your own speed for double-time printing, play the long economy game, or just mix and match all these strategies. The possibilities are endless!

Embracing Sci-fi Silliness

In a dark future, alien forces invaded Earth, seized control and destroyed all of humanity's means of resistance. However, the seemingly harmless worker droids were spared: office assistants, flyer printers, vending machines and the like. Hacked and reprogrammed for combat, they now march to take back the planet. You are one of them!

Human-Made Indie Labor of Love

Design & Code: Fabian Fischer (@Ludokultur)
Art & Animations: Victor Negreiro (@estivador)
short_desc: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.
